title: T18 independent official-source verification dossier
duration_note: A 7-night baseline does not answer 1–2 week, 2–4 week, or preferred 3-night options; those remain blank+flag.
rule: If a value is not printed by an official source, the value cell is blank and carries an unverified flag. No inferred or derived totals are entered as verified values.
pages_ready_for: Static GitHub Pages sub-site under audit/; final integration session must add shared nav links, merge, verify internal links, and republish Pages.
scope: T18 exclusive scope is audit/** plus append-only COORDINATION.md. No docs/**, deepdive/**, build*.py, content.py, README.md, or index.html files were edited in this session.
source_policy: Official place/agency pages outrank search snippets, secondary guides, and platform search links.
Dynamic quote pages are snapshots with a capture date; they are not predictions or booking-date experiments.
YouTube oEmbed confirms platform metadata only; it does not prove review quality or venue endorsement.
TikTok/Instagram search and profile links are discovery-only, not verified reviews.
Modeled coordinates, straight-line screens, arithmetic-derived totals, and community-router samples are not official-source verification.
